name: Lari Adda
summary: A goods transport desk: bilty form, loads by route, live truck map, freight and driver payments
about: A truck-art styled desk for a goods transport company running routes between Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Peshawar and Quetta, in PKR. It writes bilties (consignment notes) with freight, labour and to-pay terms, loads them on trucks, shows every truck moving on a live route map and departure board, and keeps a ledger of driver trip pay and advances. Good for a transport adda, a goods forwarding agent or a fleet owner.
how: Trucks creep along the routes on the live map and the departure board tiles flip when a trip changes status.
On Trip board, drag the look-ahead slider or press Play next 24 h to watch where every truck will be.
Open New bilty: the carbon-copy slip on the right fills in as you type, with freight from the rate card and a Paid or To pay stamp.
Press Dispatch a truck, tick the bilties waiting for that route and send it; the truck checks its tonnage.
Open a trip to see its stops, report a delay or mark it arrived, which adds the driver's trip pay.
Driver payments shows what each driver is owed after advances; Reports compare freight with diesel, tolls and pay.
